purpose: Use an iPhone-only, zero-wager manual evidence package to try to close the two remaining decisive rule bundles: exact progressive jackpot trigger and exact jackpot-qualifying wager structure.

captureOrder.instruction: Open Ultimate Video Poker, select Jotas o Mejor Progresivo without pressing Jugar, and capture the full game screen showing the selected variant, current jackpot amount, coin value, hand count, total wager if displayed, and the play button area.
Open the paytable and capture every visible row, especially ordinary Royal Flush and the separate Bote/Jackpot row, including any footnote, icon, suit marker or qualification text.
canClose: possible exact jackpot trigger if explicitly stated

captureOrder.instruction: Open Help/Rules/Info and capture every page or scroll section containing any of these concepts: Bote, Jackpot, Progresivo, Royal Flush, Escalera Real, Picas, Spades, moneda, créditos, manos, apuesta máxima, elegible, optar, premio progresivo.
canClose: exact qualifying coin/credit/hand/total-wager rule if explicit

captureOrder.instruction: Without pressing Jugar, change only the number of hands and/or coin value through available UI controls and capture the screen if the jackpot row, jackpot amount, eligibility badge, total wager or Bote display changes/enables/disables. Do not place any wager.
cannotAloneClose: jackpot eligibility unless the UI explicitly states eligibility

acceptance.jackpotTriggerVerifiedOnlyIf: Current Botemania in-game paytable/help/rules explicitly identifies the winning hand/suit or an equally exact current-game rule.
acceptance.jackpotQualifyingStakeVerifiedOnlyIf: Current Botemania in-game help/rules or an explicit eligibility indicator identifies the exact coin value, credits per hand, hand count, total wager or max-bet condition required for the jackpot.
